blockingFindings.title: Missing unchanged binding acceptance coverage
blockingFindings.issue: The spec-local R6 tests cover malformed, missing, changed HEAD, changed tree, and changed source artifact rejection, but they never assert that an unchanged valid binding is accepted. The task test strategy explicitly requires coverage for unchanged binding, and R6 acceptance requires freshness checks to accept unchanged report bindings.
blockingFindings.suggestion: Add an assertion in the R6 binding test, or a dedicated test, that calls `RunReportCommand.validateBinding()` with a valid binding and matching `current` values and verifies it does not throw. Also cover `validateFinalEvidence()` with the same unchanged binding if final-evidence acceptance is part of the production contract.
blockingFindings.rationale: R6 is a mandatory requirement and its acceptance includes both reject and accept behavior. Without an unchanged-binding acceptance assertion, the implementation could satisfy only the failure paths while still regressing valid report reuse.
